scope: Disabled-by-default automatic OCI indexing, indexed launch selection, private credential pull, verified full-archive fallback and startup cancellation. Source synchronized separately from the still-running earlier production runtime. No native provider, product timing, database or live CDN acceptance in this gate.
linuxSetupCorrection: First test invocation ended127 before running tests because SSH quoting treated the whole Node command as an executable. Corrected argument-vector invocation ran all328 checks successfully; snapshot bytes were unchanged.
checks: Enabled preparation indexes verified OCI images automatically; unsupported formats leave ready full-archive builds.
Server selects only matching index metadata; missing/corrupt metadata and disabled mode preserve full-archive selection.
Registry host comes from artifact origin; digest and launch ID determine the repository. No provider/release tokens reach user compute.
Private per-pull Docker config is0600 inside0700 temporary directory; existing user login untouched.
Indexed images always pull, even if an incomplete image ID is visible. Failure or identity mismatch forces one verified full load.
Corrupt downloaded archives never reach Docker; verified retry archives are reusable.
Parent stop and failed peer cancel active pulls without full-image fallback; cleanup waits for command exit.
Actual CLI cancellation/deadline and generic index command timeout reap the subprocess before returning. Forced termination may leave bounded index staging files for verified operator recovery.
Startup heartbeat observes stop during a stalled artifact body; no ready/failed status or app start; listeners cleaned.

codeLines.scope: Physical source lines including blanks in src/public/scripts/test/examples. Includes JS/TS/JSX/TSX, Python, Go, Java/Kotlin, C#, PHP (including artisan), Ruby (.rb/.ru and Rails bin/rails), Rust, Elixir, HTML/CSS, shell, Svelte/Vue/Astro/Razor. Excludes JSON/lockfiles, Dockerfiles, YAML, docs, dependencies and generated artifacts. Archived diagnostic reproducers under evidence/probes are excluded.
